A caret suggestion list for text fields: TextSuggestionController attaches an ITextSuggestionProvider (GetSuggestions(text, caret) -> TextSuggestionList of replace start/length and TextSuggestion rows of insert text, label, detail, description) to a TextEditWidget. A typed character asks the provider and opens the list when it answers; while open, every edit and caret move refilters (closing on none) and losing focus closes. The keyboard focus never leaves the field: the new TextEditWidget.PreviewKeyDown hands Up/Down (wrapping), PageUp/PageDown, Enter, Tab and Escape to the list before the field can edit, submit, tab away or scroll, and consumes them. Accepting (key or click) replaces the span, puts the caret after the insert and asks again at once, so an insert ending in '.' shows what follows. The list is agg drawn (label left, detail right and dimmer, the highlighted row's description in a footer, at most 8 rows scrolled by the highlight or the wheel), hangs below the word being completed through AnchoredPopup, and is parented to the outermost window and unfocusable so a click on it never unfocuses the field. TextSuggestionControllerTests pins it.
